datasets.name: ODSDepozitWithDraw
datasets.sql:
Select
    C.ID
   ,C.ContractNo
   ,C.OpenDate
   ,C.CloseDate
   ,C.Amount
   ,i.interest
   ,oi.overdueinterest as overdueinterest
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetAccNoFromID(CA.ContractAccID) as ContractAccNo
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetAccNoFromID(CA.ClientAccID) as ClientAccNo
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetAccNoFromID(CA.InterestAccID) as InterestAccNo
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetAccName(CA.ContractAccID) as ContractAccName
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetCurrencyShortName(CA.ContractAccID)as ContractCurrency
   ,SBCM_Stored_Programs.SBCMGetAccName(CA.ClientAccID) as ClientAccName
   ,p.*
  From
   SBCM_Contracts C
  ,SBCM_Contract_Accounts CA
  ,sbcm_interests i
  ,sbcm_payments p
  ,sbcm_overdueinterests oi
  Where
    C.Type# = (
       Select ID from
              SBCM_CONTRACT_TYPES
              Where upper(Name) = 'DEPOSIT'
               )
           And C.ID = CA.ID#
           And i.id# = C.ID
           and oi.id#=c.id
           and C.ID=p.id#
           and C.ID=:ContID

datasets.name: ODSContarcts
datasets.sql:
SELECT per.NAME, cat.CATEGORY, dt.TYPE
  FROM sbcm_persons per,
       sbcm_categories cat,
       sbcm_deposit_types dt,
       sbcm_contracts c
 WHERE per.ID = c.personaltype
   AND cat.ID = c.clienttype
   AND dt.ID = c.contracttype
   AND c.ID =:ContID
